description: Daily or monthly page views (user agent, all access) for up to 5 articles in one Wikipedia edition over a date range of at most one year, with totals, peak day and the change between the first and second half. mode=top lists the most viewed articles of one day. Data lags by about a day; bots and unknown agents are excluded. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

articles.description: Comma list of up to 5 article titles, underscores or spaces (mode=series)

from.description: First day YYYY-MM-DD (default 30 days before to); for mode=top, the day

mode.description: series (default) or top (most viewed articles of the day in from)

name: wiki_pageviews
title: Wiki Pageviews
